description: Logs in, searches for a member by ID, and reads their savings balance from the Account Balance panel.

memberId.description: The member ID to search for.

memberName.description: The member's full name, as displayed on the member detail page — lets the caller verify which record the balance belongs to.

savingsBalance.description: The member's savings balance, formatted as displayed (e.g. "$1,234.56").

target.name: Username
target.rationale: The Username field has a stable accessible name via its associated <label>.

target.name: Password
target.rationale: The Password field has a stable accessible name via its associated <label>.

target.name: Log In
target.rationale: The only submit control on the login form.
Fallback if the button's accessible name ever changes; scoped to the login form specifically to avoid matching an unrelated submit button.

target.name: Member ID
target.rationale: The search field's accessible name for the default tenant; overridden to "Account Number" for the beta tenant via the tenant overlay.

target.name: Search
target.rationale: The search form's submit control for the default tenant; overridden to "Find" for the beta tenant via the tenant overlay.

target.description: the value cell in the row whose row header is "Name"
target.rationale: The name value cell has no accessible name of its own (mirrors the balance panel's row-header pattern) — the row header is the only reliable, non-positional signal.

target.description: the value cell in the row whose row header is "Savings"
target.rationale: The balance value cell has no accessible name of its own (evidence/accessibility-snapshot-spike/balance-panel.aria.yaml) — the row header is the only reliable, non-positional signal.
